prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"upload_photos": {"headline": "Upload Clear Pet Photos", "body": "Follow the visual framing guides so your custom pet generates accurately.", "layout": "split", "components": [{"type": "photo_picker", "label": "Select Pet Photos", "style": "rounded", "action": "choose"}]}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Your existing pet data and adoption progress will automatically sync upon logging in.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Data Restoration Active", "style": "subtle"}]}}
2: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Waiting Tip Carousel: Add interactive pet care tips and explicit estimated waiting time during pet generation.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Discover how your pet interacts with desktop windows while waiting.", "style": "playful", "action": "open_tip"}]}}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_overlay_check"], "new_overlay_check": {"headline": "Confirm Desktop Visibility", "body": "Ensure your companion is visible and positioned comfortably on your desktop screen.", "layout": "centered", "button_label": "Finish Onboarding"}}

   config: {"_order": ["choose_path", "story", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "choose_path": {"headline": "Choose Your Companion Journey", "body": "Select how you want to create or adopt your desktop pet."}}

   config: {"pick_friend": {"headline": "Meet Your Perfect Desktop Buddy", "body": "Select a companion with personality traits tailored to your daily desk work rhythm."}}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_desktop_launch"], "home_intro": {"button_label": "Start Quick Interaction Setup"}, "new_desktop_launch": {"headline": "Desktop Controls Quick Launch", "body": "Learn how to move, hide, and converse with your pet using desktop shortcuts.", "layout": "card", "button_label": "Complete Setup"}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Welcome Back to Your Desktop Pet", "layout": "compact", "show_progress": true}}
8: [adoption, hint] Certificate Naming Prompt Hint: Add a helpful hint on the adoption certificate screen to guide pet naming and personality confirmation.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"hint": "Give your pet a unique name and personality trait to officially finalize your adoption certificate."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the photo upload screen into a split view retains its functionality and remains entirely within onboarding limits.
Adding a sign-in reassurance badge and hint does not alter pricing or essential screen jobs and is permitted under rule 4.
Adding estimated wait time and interactive tips on the waiting screen is explicitly allowed under rule 4 and compliant with rule 5.
Adding a new verification screen following home_intro is allowed as part of onboarding flexibility under rule 4.
Reordering onboarding screens is permitted under rule 4, and both screens retain their required core jobs.
Updating pick_friend copy to emphasize companion traits retains the core functionality of letting the user choose a pet.
Adding a new setup launch screen after home_intro is permitted as part of onboarding additions under rule 4.
Re-framing sign-in into a compact layout with progress tracking retains sign-in functionality and complies with rule 4.
Adding a helpful hint to the adoption certificate screen preserves the official stamp and certificate functionality.
Adding a background rendering hint to the waiting screen is permitted waiting-screen information under rule 4.
